_instructions: SYNEXA REAL RAG EVALUATION BENCHMARK DATASET
This dataset contains verified, manually reviewed test cases grounded in
the repository's real document 'Synexa.docx' (indexed under doc_8033d05356d5),
along with negative guardrail test cases and template entries for new uploads.
Rules for adding your own benchmark questions:
1. Set 'is_template': false ONLY after verifying ground-truth content.
2. 'expected_source_document' must exactly match the filename in chunk metadata.
3. 'expected_pages' must match the page numbers where evidence appears.
4. 'expected_evidence_keywords' must be terms extracted directly from source text.
5. For ungrounded or out-of-domain questions, set 'allow_refusal': true.
